title: Button Press Module
description: This is a Button Press BBBoat Hud Module.
body:
This is a BBBoat Hud Module.

It adds a HUD where movement/mouse/space icons are displayed.

Requires `BBBoat Hud` and `More BBBoat Hud`.

Use `/bb_boat_hud` command to open the configuration interface in your web browser.
Select `Add Modules` and click `NapsterNPT` then `button_press.lua`
